# OMNIVOX

> UK/EU cloud contact centre: preview, progressive, and power dial with AMD, inbound ACD, a Work Inbox, and floor wallboards. Prepaid voice at about 5p outbound and 4p inbound.

OMNIVOX is operated by Quanterae Solutions. The platform fee is £25 per agent per month (sales policy). Voice telephony is prepaid: about 5p per connected outbound minute and 4p per connected inbound minute. SMS, WhatsApp, email, chat, and social DMs are not billed from Call Credits. There is no bundled “unlimited minutes” fair-use cap — voice usage is visible in Admin → Call Credits.

## Product facts

- Manual, preview, progressive, and power dial are available today. AMD is on progressive and power.
- Predictive Live is waitlist only — not enabled in production
- Work Inbox catalog: SMS, WhatsApp (24-hour customer-care sessions, not HSM broadcasts), email, live chat, Facebook/Instagram/X DMs
- Catalog live does not mean an organisation is ready — enable channels in Admin → Channels
- Floor wallboards include a Digital waiting lane
- Voice Call Credits wallet: ~5p outbound / ~4p inbound, one-minute minimum. Digital is not in this wallet
- Platform-managed Twilio telephony — no carrier accounts required
- Call recording is configurable per organisation or campaign
- UK GDPR: the customer is the data controller; OMNIVOX is the data processor
- A Data Processing Agreement is provided at onboarding
- No SOC 2, ISO, PCI, native iOS/Android, or CRM marketplace claims
- Contact: hello@omnivox.co.uk
- App login: https://omnivox.vercel.app/login
